1.text: Rasheli abonye yuko atabyaranye na Yakobo agirira mukuru we ishyari, abwira Yakobo ati “Mpa abana, nutabampa simbaho.”

2.text: Rasheli yikongereza uburakari bwa Yakobo aramubaza ati “Ndi mu cyimbo cy'Imana se, ko ari yo yakwimye imbuto iva mu nda yawe?”

3.text: Aramusubiza ati “Dore umuja wanjye Biluha umugire inshoreke, kugira ngo abyarire ku mavi yanjye, nanjye mbonere urubyaro kuri we.”

4.text: Amushyingira Biluha umuja we, Yakobo amugira inshoreke.

5.text: Biluha asama inda, abyarana na Yakobo umuhungu.

6.text: Rasheli aravuga ati “Imana inciriye urubanza ndatsinda, kandi inyumviye impa umuhungu.” Ni cyo cyatumye amwita Dani.

7.text: Biluha umuja wa Rasheli asama indi nda, abyarana na Yakobo umuhungu wa kabiri.

8.text: Rasheli aravuga ati “Nkiranije mwene data gukirana gukabije, ndamutsinda.” Amwita Nafutali.

9.text: Leya abonye yuko yarekeye aho kubyara, yenda Zilupa umuja we, amushyingira Yakobo.

10.text: Zilupa umuja wa Leya abyarana na Yakobo umuhungu.

11.text: Leya aravuga ati “Mbonye umugisha.” Amwita Gadi.

12.text: Zilupa umuja wa Leya abyarana na Yakobo umuhungu wa kabiri.

13.text: Leya aravuga ati “Ndahiriwe, kuko abakobwa bazanyita umunyehirwe.” Amwita Asheri.

14.text: Mu isarura ry'ingano, Rubeni ajya mu gasozi, abona amadudayimu, ayazanira nyina Leya. Rasheli abwira Leya ati “Ndakwinginze, mpa ku madudayimu y'umwana wawe.”

15.text: Na we aramusubiza ati “Kuntwara umugabo biroroheje, none urashaka kuntwara n'amadudayimu y'umwana wanjye?”Rasheli aramusubiza ati “None iri joro arakurarira numpa amadudayimu y'umwana wawe.”

16.text: Yakobo nimugoroba ava mu rwuri, Leya arasohoka aramusanganira, aramubwira ati “Ukwiriye kundarira, kuko ntanze amadudayimu y'umwana wanjye ho ibihembo.” Amurarira iryo joro.

17.text: Imana yumvira Leya asama inda, abyarana na Yakobo umuhungu wa gatanu.

18.text: Leya aravuga ati “Imana impaye ibihembo, kuko nashyingiye umugabo wanjye umuja wanjye.” Amwita Isakari.

19.text: Leya asama indi nda, abyarana na Yakobo umuhungu wa gatandatu.

20.text: Leya aravuga ati “Imana impaye impano nziza, noneho umugabo wanjye azabana nanjye, kuko twabyaranye abahungu batandatu.” Amwita Zebuluni.

22.text: Imana yibuka Rasheli iramwumvira, izibura inda ye.

23.text: Asama inda abyara umuhungu ati “Imana inkuyeho igitutsi.”

24.text: Amwita Yosefu ati “Uwiteka anyongere undi muhungu.”

25.text: Nuko Rasheli amaze kubyara Yosefu, Yakobo abwira Labani ati “Nsezerera ngende, njye iwacu mu gihugu cyacu.

26.text: Mpa abagore banjye n'abana banjye nagutenderagaho nigendere, kuko uzi gutenda nagutenzeho.”

27.text: Labani aramubwira ati “Icyampa nkakugiriraho umugisha! Kuko nahanuye yuko ari ku bwawe Uwiteka yampereye umugisha.”

29.text: Aramusubiza ati “Uzi uko nagutenzeho, kandi uko amatungo yawe yabaye nyaragira.

30.text: Kuko ayo wari ufite ntaraza yari make, none yarororotse aba menshi cyane. Uwiteka yaguhaye umugisha aho naganaga hose, none nzabona ryari ibitungisha urwanjye rugo?”

31.text: Aramubaza ati “Nzaguhemba iki?”Yakobo aramusubiza ati “Nta cyo uzampemba, ahubwo nunkorera iki, nzongera nkuragirire umukumbi, nywurinde.

32.text: Uyu munsi ndaca mu mukumbi wawe wose, nkuremo intama z'ubugondo zose n'iz'ibitobo zose n'intama z'ibikara zose, n'ihene z'ibitobo n'iz'ubugondo, izimeze zityo zizaba ibihembo byanjye.

33.text: Gukiranuka kwanjye kuzamburanira gutya hanyuma: nuza kwitegereza ibihembo byanjye biri imbere yawe, ihene yose itari ubugondo cyangwa igitobo, n'intama yose itari igikara nizimbonekaho, uzazite inyibano.”

34.text: Labani aramusubiza ati “Nkunze ko byaba bityo.”

35.text: Nuko uwo munsi arobanura amapfizi y'ihene y'ibihuga, n'inyagazi z'ubugondo n'iz'ibitobo zose, ihene yose ifite ibara ry'umweru, n'intama z'ibikara zose, aziha abahungu be.

36.text: Hagati yabo na Yakobo ahashyira urugendo rw'iminsi itatu. Yakobo aragira imikumbi ya Labani isigaye.

37.text: Yakobo yenda uduti tw'imilebeni tubisi, n'utw'imiluzi n'utw'imyarumoni, adushishuraho amabara maremare asa n'imisengo, agaragaza umweru wo kuri two.

38.text: Ashyira uduti yashishuye ku bibumbiro byo ku mabuga aho imikumbi iri bunywere. Zarindaga uko zije kunywa.

39.text: Imikumbi yarindiraga imbere y'utwo duti, zikabyara iz'ibihuga n'iz'ubugondo n'iz'ibitobo.

40.text: Yakobo akarobanura izivutse, akerekeranya izo mu mukumbi wa Labani n'iz'ibihuga n'iz'ibikara, agashyira imikumbi ye ukwayo, ntayiteranye n'iya Labani.

41.text: Kandi uko inziza zo mu mukumbi zirinze, Yakobo yashyiraga twa duti ku bibumbiro imbere y'umukumbi, kugira ngo zitēgere hagati yatwo.

42.text: Ariko zaba mbi ntadushyireho, bituma imbi ziba iza Labani, inziza zikaba iza Yakobo.

43.text: Uwo mugabo agwiza ubutunzi cyane, agira imikumbi myinshi n'abaja n'abagaragu, n'ingamiya n'indogobe.
